name: MV Sample Coaster
disclaimer: Modeled sample vessel. Hull form, compartment layout, component list, materials, repair times and dependencies are a documented simulation built for this demo. They are not measurements of any real ship and must not be used for engineering decisions.

superstructure.note: Modeled: three-tier deckhouse aft, bridge on the top tier.

decks.name: Tank Top
decks.note: Modeled: inner bottom / bilge level, machinery foundations.

decks.name: Engine Room Platform
decks.note: Modeled: intermediate grating platform through the machinery space.

decks.name: Main Deck
decks.note: Modeled: weather deck, hatch coamings over the cargo holds.

decks.name: Bridge Deck
decks.note: Modeled: navigation bridge, top tier of the deckhouse.

compartments.name: Steering Gear Room
compartments.note: Modeled: steering gear flat, extended abaft the transom to carry the stern gear.

compartments.name: Auxiliary Machinery Space
compartments.note: Modeled: pumps, air compressors and the shaft tunnel entry.

compartments.name: Engine Control Room
compartments.note: Modeled: insulated control room with main switchboard and alarm panel.

compartments.name: Engine Room (Lower)
compartments.note: Modeled: main engine, cooling loop, bilge system at tank-top level.

compartments.name: Engine Room (Platform)
compartments.note: Modeled: upper machinery platform, generators and separators.

compartments.name: Fuel Oil Tank (Port)
compartments.note: Modeled: port wing bunker tank alongside the machinery space.

compartments.name: Fuel Oil Tank (Starboard)
compartments.note: Modeled: starboard wing bunker tank, mirror of the port tank.

compartments.name: Cargo Hold No.1
compartments.note: Modeled: aft cargo hold, box-shaped, single hatch.

compartments.name: Cargo Hold No.2
compartments.note: Modeled: forward cargo hold, narrows with the hull form.

compartments.name: Forepeak / Bow Thruster Room
compartments.note: Modeled: forepeak ballast tank and bow thruster tunnel.

compartments.name: Navigation Bridge
compartments.note: Modeled: wheelhouse, top tier of the deckhouse.

compartments.name: Forecastle Deck
compartments.note: Modeled: open forecastle with anchor handling and forward mooring.

compartments.name: Cargo Deck
compartments.note: Modeled: weather deck over the holds, hatch covers and the deck crane.

compartments.name: Aft Working Deck
compartments.note: Modeled: deck around the house, survival craft and aft mooring.

compartments.name: Funnel & Mast Deck
compartments.note: Modeled: uppermost deck carrying the funnel casing and the main mast.
